raw_response: DESCRIPTION: The chart, titled "Daily New Cases and Number of News Media Reports Trend," displays two data series over time: the daily number of new confirmed cases and the number of news media reports related to COVID-19. The horizontal axis represents the date, spanning from July 1, 2022, to August 26, 2022, with labels for specific dates. The left vertical axis, labeled "Daily New Confirmed Cases," measures values from 0 to 1,800,000 in increments of 200,000, corresponding to the height of the green bars. The right vertical axis, labeled "Number of News Media Reports per Day," measures values from 0 to 6,000 in increments of 1,000, corresponding to the blue line graph. The green bars, representing the global confirmed cases, show significant variation, with the highest bar reaching approximately 1,600,000 around July 15, 2022, and the lowest bar falling below 200,000 around August 19, 2022. The blue line, representing the number of news media reports, fluctuates more smoothly, peaking at approximately 5,000 reports around July 15, 2022, and reaching its lowest point at around 2,000 reports in early August. The bars and line are plotted against the same timeline, allowing for a visual comparison of the two trends.
